cues.text: In the dorm's command room, everyone sits around the low table: you, Yukari and Junpei on stools, Akihiko, Mitsuru and Fuuka on the sofa, and Chairman Ikutsuki in an armchair. Akihiko and Mitsuru sit with their arms folded.
Fuuka, who sprang to her feet with a hand at her chest when the chairman spoke to her, sits back down on the edge of the sofa.
